value.rationale: The restricted-transposition graph is a natural Markov-chain state space. The first loss of self-centeredness is a motivated finite structural boundary, unlike an arbitrary parameter slice, and the exact inversion pairing of all twenty hardest pairs gives canonical sharp worst-case geodesic examples. It refines known connectedness, degree, and local cycle counts; no unsupported larger-order extension is claimed.
